name: qfd_cb16c_es199-es199-COMMIT
purpose: CB16c-COLL: collective face edge slice qfd_coll_eslice199 (ALT regional split of the COLLIO faces)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_coll_eslice199 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS  --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/qwen_coll_cb16c_1022/qfd_coll_face_cx.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_cb16c_es199/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_cb16c_es199/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_cb16c_es199 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_coll_eslice199  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: CB16c-COLL 10-22: collective face edge register slice qfd_coll_eslice199 (199 b, one stage d->q, ck N), the regional sub-tile of qfd_coll_face_cx: 6 instances per face on their own clock entries (W tx_data / rx_data: 182 b on cal_ck_t* / rx_rck_r*; E phy_tx / phy_rx: 199 b on codec0p_t* / codec0p_r*), hardened once. Outline = one third of the face bus (145.8 um of pins at the face pin pitch); recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die.
